_comment: PII linter hook for Claude Code.
Install: copy this file to ~/.claude/settings.json (user-wide) or
.claude/settings.json (per-project) and merge with your existing config.
PreToolUse:  before Claude writes/edits a file, scan it. Exit 2 on
HIGH+ to block the tool result and force Claude to redact
before the bad bytes are ever written.
PostToolUse: after Claude writes/edits a file, scan it. Belt-and-braces
in case PreToolUse is skipped. Exit 2 on HIGH+.
Stop:        at end-of-turn, scan the staged diff. Exit 2 to force
Claude to continue and clean up before signing off.
tool call. Adjust if you have other tools named Write/Edit.
PreToolUse uses a separate __PII_PRETOOLUSE_PATH__ script. The install
command patches that placeholder to the absolute path of the script
after copying it next to settings.json (under .claude/hooks/).

hooks.command: bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.csv|*.jsonl|*.md) pii-lint scan -- "$f" || exit 2;; esac'
